name: ZML-Push
author: 紫茉莉.ME

sections.description:
ZML-Push，Automatically push content to search engines.

Automatically push to IndexNow when publishing articles.

External services

This plugin connects to the API to complete URL submit.
Each time it is used, it sends the user’s post URL.
This service is provided by “IndexNow.org”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Plugin requirements

  • PHP 7.3 and later versions.
  • WordPress 5.6 and later versions.
  • It is recommended to use the latest versions of PHP and WordPress.

Plugin settings

  • No setup is required; the plugin will run automatically once enabled.
